{{Quote|You think you can defeat me? Fool! This blade is the product of untold millennia of Sith alchemy! Against such power, your Jedi toy is but a broken reed!|Lord Shadowspawn|<ref name="SOM" />}}
The persona of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]] created by Lord Cronal owned and used a [[Sword/Legends|sword]] imbued with [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. Shadowspawn led the [[Legions of Shadow]] and his physical presence was often portrayed through a [[Pawn]].<ref name="SOM" />

==Description==
{{Quote|In this you are doomed to disappointment.|Lord Shadowspawn|<ref name="SOM" />}}
Shadowspawn's sword was imbued with Sith alchemy and glared [[Color/Legends|scarlet]]. He kept it in a [[Scabbard/Legends|scabbard]]. The blade was huge, a hand wide and half again longer than [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|Luke's lightsaber]]. It appeared to be cut from a faceted crystal like a single large diamond. The crystal in question was [[meltmassif]]. Despite its imbuement, it couldn't withstand a lightsaber, as a decimeter of its end was cut off when he and Luke clashed blades.<ref name="SOM" />

==History==
{{Quote|Come, Skywalker! Summon your blade and fight! Destroy me, and my men will instead serve you!|Lord Shadowspawn|<ref name="SOM" />}}
Shadowspawn's sword was imbued with Sith alchemy. Cronal, controlling [[Nick Rostu]] who was playing the physical presence of Shadowspawn, claimed it was the product of untold millennia of Sith alchemy.<ref name="SOM" />

[[File:Battle of Mindor.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Shadowspawn used the sword to battle Luke Skywalker in the Cavern of the Shadow Throne.]]
Cronal created the persona of Shadowspawn as the leader of the Legions of Shadow to attack the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and lure [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]] so he may take over his body. When Luke was lured to Mindor, he was brought before Shadowspawn, who as usual was in actuality a Pawn controlled by Cronal, in the [[Cavern of the Shadow Throne]]. After an exchange of words, Shadowspawn unsheathed the sword from its scabbard, forcing Luke to take out his own lightsaber. Shadowspawn's combat was considered to have the subtlety and grace of a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] swinging a [[Sonic hammer/Legends|sonic hammer]], with Luke musing that Shadowspawn's attacks looked like someone who had heard of swordplay but never actually seen it. The one time Luke and Shadowspawn clashed blades, a decimeter of the end of Shadowspawn's blade was severed. Shadowspawn continually missed his strikes until Luke punched him in the face and ripped off his crown to find it was not actually Cronal who was present like he had assumed, but one of Cronal's Pawns known as Nick Rostu. This final move by Luke went against Cronal's plans, who intended Luke to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Nick with his lightsaber as he was recording the whole fight to make a reality [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]].<ref name="SOM" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The only reference I had for Shadowspawn was the Tommy Lee Edwards pic for ''The Essential Chronology'' [sic]&hellip;and it was thankfully very abstracted, so I got to fill in lots of detail. I got a kind of Napoleon-Revolutionary War Admiral-Pirate-Samurai kind of vibe from it, and went with it for character design. I loved that he had an over-scaled sword hilt on his lightsaber that looked Middle Ages in a Japanese-techno vein&hellip;so I gave him a shortsword-tanto to go with it&hellip;all very east-meets-west.|Dave Seeley|<ref name="Seeley Blog">{{OfficialBlog|url=2008/06/16/dave-seeley-talks-mindors-got-back|text=Dave Seeley Talks: <i>Mindor</i>'s Got Back|date=2008-06-16}}</ref>}}
[[File:ShadowSpawnZoom.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Shadowspawn was depicted with sword and a dagger on the back cover of ''Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor''. Said dagger did not appear in the book.]]
Shadowspawn's sword was first pictured in the [[2005]] reference book, [[The New Essential Chronology|''The'' ''New Essential Chronology'']] where it was drawn by [[Tommy Lee Edwards]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> But didn't make its first appearance until [[2008|2008's]] ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' written by [[Matthew Stover]].<ref name="SOM" /> While reading the [[Jedi Council Forums]] the cover artist for Shadows of Mindor, [[Dave Seeley]], noted that some people were disappointed with Shadowspawn not being present on the cover. This prompted Seeley to make a back cover for the book featuring Shadowspawn,<ref name="Seeley Blog" /> however, the back cover portrays Shadowspawn with two swords, the main one and an additional dagger. The dagger was a liberty of the cover as it does not appear in the book.<ref name="SOM" />

Despite Shadows of Mindor implying that Shadowspawn's sword is one-of-a-kind,<ref name="SOM" /> [[The Unknown Regions]] portrays a [[Sorcerers of Rhand|Sorcerer of Rhand]] wielding two swords similar to those of Shadowspawn, including a similar outfit.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
